preamble:
Time zone data for generators and queries.

Add data with Zone_source.add_tzif, Zone_source.add_zone or Zone_source.add_oracle, and aliases with Zone_source.add_link. For lazy loading, use Zone_source.declare and Zone_source.set_loader. Adding data replaces any existing data for that name. Add or declare names before drawing.

  let source =
    let source = Temporal.Zone_source.create () in
    Temporal.Zone_source.declare source [ "America/New_York"; "Europe/London" ];
    Temporal.Zone_source.set_loader source (fun source name ->
      let path = Filename.concat "/usr/share/zoneinfo" name in
      match In_channel.with_open_bin path In_channel.input_all with
      | contents -> Temporal.Zone_source.add_tzif source name ~contents
      | exception Sys_error _ -> ());
    source
  ;;

  let%hegel_test zoned tc =
    let z = draw tc (Temporal.zoned_datetimes ~source ()) in
    ignore z
  ;;

Create sources outside test bodies and reuse them across test cases. Invalid data or calls raise Usage_error.
content:
type t

A zone source.

type zone_type = {
  1. offset_seconds : int;
  2. is_dst : bool;
  3. abbreviation : string;
}

A local time type of a zone: an offset of less than two days in seconds east of UTC, its daylight-saving flag (reported by offset_at) and its abbreviation, such as EST.

type zone_transition = {
  1. instant : int;
  2. local_type : zone_type;
}

An explicit transition: from instant (Unix seconds) on, local_type is in force.

type rule_day =
  1. | Julian of int
    (*

    Jn: the day of the year in [1, 365], February 29 never counted.

    *)
  2. | Zero_based of int
    (*

    n: the zero-based day of the year in [0, 365], February 29 counted.

    *)
  3. | Month_week_day of {
    1. month : month;
    2. week : int;
    3. weekday : weekday;
    }
    (*

    Mm.w.d: the weekth weekday of month, week in [1, 5] with 5 meaning the last.

    *)

The transition day in a POSIX TZ rule (RFC 9636 §3.3.1).

type rule_date = {
  1. day : rule_day;
  2. time : int;
}

When a yearly rule's transition happens: time seconds (within ±167 hours) after local midnight of day, in the offset in force before the transition.

type dst_rule = {
  1. daylight : zone_type;
  2. starts : rule_date;
  3. ends : rule_date;
}

The daylight-saving half of a zone_rule: the daylight type is in force from starts to ends each year.

type zone_rule = {
  1. standard : zone_type;
  2. dst : dst_rule option;
}

A zone's rule for every year after its last explicit transition, the footer of a TZif file: a standard type and, when the zone observes daylight saving time, a dst_rule. The rule must agree with the local type immediately after the last explicit transition.

type after =
  1. | Hold
    (*

    Keep the last local type indefinitely.

    *)
  2. | Rule of zone_rule
    (*

    The yearly rule.

    *)
  3. | Infer of int
    (*

    Infer a yearly rule from the given year and the preceding year. If no rule is found, keep the last local type.

    *)

What a zone has in force after its last explicit transition.

type zone_data = {
  1. initial : zone_type;
  2. transitions : zone_transition list;
  3. after : after;
}

A zone's data as fields, the TZif model of RFC 9636: the type in force before the first transition, the transitions strictly ascending by instant, and what follows them.

val bundled : unit -> t

bundled () is the IANA database bundled with Hegel. It cannot be changed: every add_* and set_* function raises on it.

val create : unit -> t

create () is a new, empty source.

val add_tzif : t -> string -> contents:string -> unit

add_tzif source name ~contents adds the zone name from the contents of a TZif file (RFC 9636, version 2 or later), such as one under /usr/share/zoneinfo. The name must be nonempty, contain no NUL bytes and differ from unknown_zone.

val add_zone : t -> string -> zone_data -> unit

add_zone source name data adds the zone name from its data as fields.

val add_oracle : t -> string -> ?next_transition:(int -> int option) -> ?first_year:int -> ?last_year:int -> ?infer:bool -> (int -> zone_type) -> unit

add_oracle source name offset_at imports a zone through lookup callbacks. offset_at returns the local type at a Unix timestamp. The import covers first_year (default 1900) through last_year (default 2100).

next_transition returns the first transition after the given timestamp, or None if there are no more. Without it, transitions less than a day apart may be missed.

Outside the imported range, the first and last local types apply. With ~infer:true, later years instead use a yearly rule inferred from the last two years. Callbacks run synchronously on the calling thread. Callback exceptions become Usage_error with the original message.

val add_link : t -> string -> target:string -> unit

add_link source name ~target makes name a link to target, whose data then applies to both. The target need not have data, or be known, yet.

val declare : t -> string list -> unit

declare source names registers names for loading later, leaving existing entries unchanged. Supply their data through a loader or an add_* call before use. A draw or query that needs missing data raises Usage_error. Drawing zones without ~names loads all eligible names; with ~names, it loads only those names.

val set_loader : t -> (t -> string -> unit) -> unit

set_loader source load calls load source name when a draw or query needs missing zone data. The callback should use an add_* function to add the zone or a link. If it adds nothing, the name remains unknown; this is an error for a declared name.

The callback runs on the drawing or querying thread. Calls may be concurrent or repeated for the same name. It must not draw values. Exceptions become Usage_error with the original message.

Add data to the source passed to load; do not capture source in the callback.

val remove_loader : t -> unit

remove_loader source removes the loader. Missing names can no longer be loaded.

val set_version : t -> string -> unit

set_version source version records which release of its database the source holds, such as "2026e".

val version : t -> string

version source returns tzdb_version for the bundled source, or the string recorded by set_version. Returns "" if unset.
